Jamie Metzl questions the origins of COVID-19 in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience. Metzl, a national security expert who served on a WHO advisory group, broke ranks early to say the lab-leak idea deserved a real hearing. His standing makes his doubts hard to wave away.

He walks Rogan through the gaps in the official inquiry and the records he says were never chased. Rogan asks why the question was treated as settled before it was studied. The segment is a careful, sourced entry in the origins fight, from a critic who came from inside the system he questions.

Physicist Thomas Campbell presents his theory of everything in episode 2259 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Campbell worked for NASA and defense projects before writing My Big TOE, his trilogy on reality. TOE stands for theory of everything, and his version starts with consciousness, not matter.

Campbell argues the universe works like a virtual reality computed by a larger consciousness. He says love and lowered fear are the point of the system, not just physics puzzles. Rogan works through the model step by step, testing it against near-death stories and meditation. It is a long, patient walk through a very big claim.
